ai_language_tip: Start in Latvian (lv); Latvian is the required language of service. In Riga and Latgale many staff also speak Russian; English is common with younger staff in Riga. Switch only if the other side does.
english_ok: often — Good in central Riga, Jūrmala hotels and restaurants; limited in small-town clinics, garages and state offices.
politeness: Reserved and polite; formal 'Jūs'; open with 'Labdien'; little small talk; close with 'Paldies, uz redzēšanos'.
name_tip: Booking 'uz vārdu …'; Latvian surnames are gendered (-s/-š for men, -a/-e for women, e.g. Bērziņš / Bērziņa); foreign names get Latvianised in writing, so spell the exact form needed.
phone_tip: All numbers 8 digits, mobile starting with 2 (e.g. 2 12345678), Riga landlines 67/66; international +371; no trunk prefix; SMS and e-mail confirmations standard.
time_tip: Watch out: 'pusastoņos' = 7:30 (half to eight), 'ceturksnis pāri septiņiem' = 7:15; written 24h ('19:30'); always read back in 24h.
number_tip: 8-digit numbers are read in pairs or 2-3-3; numerals are gendered ('divi'/'divas').
avoid_calling: Avoid restaurant peaks 12:00–13:00 and 18:30–20:00, calls after 20:00, Sundays for non-hospitality, and Jāņi (Midsummer 23–24 June) when the country largely stops.
closed_days: Shops and malls open on Sunday; offices and many clinics closed weekends; holidays include Good Friday, Easter, 1 and 4 May, 23–24 June, 18 November, 24–26 and 31 December.
booking_channels: Piearsta.lv and clinic e-pieraksts for doctors (state-funded queues via e-veselība referral); Table.lv, Tablein.lv and Meniu.lv for restaurant tables; Wolt and Bolt Food for delivery; salons by phone or online widgets.
voice_menu: Clinics with large registries, banks, LMT/Tele2/Bite, Latvijas Pasts and utilities use IVR; restaurants and small salons answer directly.
callback_habits: Table.lv confirms by SMS; clinics send SMS reminders; small businesses call or text back.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 里加中心區餐廳常同時接電話與 Table.lv／Tablein 線上訂位（Table.lv 以簡訊確認）；仲夏節 Jāņi（6/23–24）與年底聖誕宴期間很多店改包場或休息。

may_come_up.what: Table.lv sends an SMS confirmation instead of a call
Group menu or advance payment for Christmas parties (Ziemassvētku ballītes)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for card details to guarantee a large table

usually_asked: Booking date and time, e.g. Friday 19:00
How many people the table (galdiņš) is for
Hall or summer terrace, and whether a high chair is needed
Name and mobile number for the SMS confirmation

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 國家給付門診要家庭醫師（ģimenes ārsts）的電子轉診並排隊，常等數週；自費（maksas）門診可電話或 Piearsta.lv 隔天就約到，診所會先問付費或用轉診。

may_come_up.what: State-funded queue is weeks long; offer of a paid slot sooner
Directs to Piearsta.lv for the slot list

sensitive_asked.what: Asks personas kods to check the e-veselība referral

usually_asked: State-paid with GP referral (nosūtījums) or paid visit (maksas)
Which specialist or test is needed
Patient full name (personal code asked at the desk)
First visit or follow-up at this clinic
Mobile number for the reminder SMS

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 里加美髮美甲多有 Instagram 或線上預約連結，但多數師傅仍接電話；老客戶常直接指定同一位 meistare。

may_come_up.what: Colouring takes 2–3 hours, so only morning slots fit

usually_asked: A named master (meistare) or whoever is free

repair.before_dialing_zh: 拉脫維亞 12 月起冬胎規定讓 10–11 月換胎（riepu maiņa）店滿檔，修車廠電話預約為主；技術檢驗（tehniskā apskate）在 CSDD 線上排。

may_come_up.what: Tyre-storage fee for the season
CSDD roadworthiness test is booked on CSDD site, not at the garage

usually_asked: Car make, model and plate number
Job: tyre change (riepu maiņa), service or diagnostics
Whether tyres are stored at the garage (riepu glabāšana)

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩與亞洲餐館電話訂自取（līdzņemšanai）可行，但多數人改用 Wolt 或 Bolt Food，店家有時會請你直接在 App 下單。

may_come_up.what: Restaurant points you to its Wolt page for delivery

usually_asked: What time it will be collected

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕店（kūkas pasūtījums）多要求 2–3 天前預訂並先付訂金；花店與肉鋪可電話留貨，量販與電子產品走線上。

may_come_up.what: Advance payment for custom cakes

usually_asked: What exactly (cake, flowers, meat) and how much
Text or decoration wanted on the cake

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消自費門診通常要 24 小時前通知；Table.lv 訂位可用簡訊連結自己改。

may_come_up.what: No-show fee at private clinics

usually_asked: Name the booking was made under

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 打電話問營業時間、價格或有沒有貨都很普遍，店員回答直接簡短。

may_come_up.what: Holiday opening hours around Jāņi and Christmas

usually_asked: The exact question: price, stock or opening hours

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 里加與尤爾馬拉飯店電話或 Email 訂房，鄉間民宿（viesu nams）多半只接電話與 Email，常附三溫暖（pirts）另計。

may_come_up.what: Pirts rental is extra and booked by the hour

usually_asked: Whether sauna (pirts) or breakfast is wanted

activity.before_dialing_zh: 鄉間三溫暖屋（pirts）、SPA 與里加導覽多電話訂；冬季週末三溫暖最難訂。

may_come_up.what: Minimum booking of 3 hours for a pirts house

usually_asked: Which: sauna house, spa treatment or guided tour

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 里加公寓多為蘇聯時期樓房無電梯，水電、搬家師傅會問樓層與門禁密碼；ss.lv 上很多個人師傅只接電話。

may_come_up.what: Call-out fee (izsaukuma maksa)

usually_asked: Address, floor and whether there is a lift

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（veterinārā klīnika）電話預約，疫苗需帶寵物護照；美容依犬種估時間。

may_come_up.what: Pet passport needed for rabies vaccination

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Latvijas Pasts、Omniva、DPD、Venipak 都靠包裹機（pakomāts）與簡訊取件碼，查件改用官網追蹤，人工客服少。

may_come_up.what: Directs to online tracking

usually_asked: Phone number that receives the SMS

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（LMT、Tele2、Bite）與銀行客服要本人以 Smart-ID 或 eParaksts 驗證，代打只能問一般資訊。

may_come_up.what: Only the contract holder can proceed

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Smart-ID PIN or personas kods

transport.before_dialing_zh: 里加叫車多用 Bolt App；傳統計程車行（taksometrs）仍接電話，機場接送可預約固定價。

may_come_up.what: Fixed airport price vs meter

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多在 ss.lv 刊登並請你打電話約看屋；簽約時常收首月租金、一個月押金與仲介佣金，冬季公共費用（komunālie）偏高。

may_come_up.what: One-month deposit plus agent commission
Winter utilities estimate

sensitive_asked.what: Asks personal code or employment proof

usually_asked: How many will live there, any pets

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 戶籍申報、證件等多在 Latvija.gov.lv／iLatvija 線上辦；學校與幼兒園報名有線上排隊，電話只答一般問題。

may_come_up.what: Directs to the e-service portal

usually_asked: Which service: address declaration or documents
